description: A small labeled multi-domain retrieval corpus for the Antumbra embedder benchmark. Each domain has a set of documents and a set of (query, relevant_doc_id) labels. The corpus is deliberately small and lexically grounded so the deterministic FixedEmbedder baseline (fused with the BM25 sparse leg in recall_hybrid) produces stable, sane metrics with no network; a real Matryoshka HTTP embedder (env-gated) is expected to do at least as well on the semantic queries.

documents.text: fn reverse_string(s: &str) -> String { s.chars().rev().collect() }
fn binary_search(xs: &[i32], target: i32) -> Option<usize> { let (mut lo, mut hi) = (0, xs.len()); while lo < hi { let mid = (lo + hi) / 2; } None }
fn read_file_to_string(path: &Path) -> std::io::Result<String> { std::fs::read_to_string(path) }
async fn http_get(url: &str) -> Result<String> { reqwest::get(url).await?.text().await }
fn fibonacci(n: u64) -> u64 { if n < 2 { n } else { fibonacci(n - 1) + fibonacci(n - 2) } }
fn parse_json(input: &str) -> serde_json::Result<Value> { serde_json::from_str(input) }
fn sort_descending(v: &mut Vec<i32>) { v.sort_unstable_by(|a, b| b.cmp(a)); }
